stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class, ADM2023); no Common Data Set is published on NSU's Institutional Research page (checked 2026-10-26). College Navigator also shows fall 2024: 1,086 applicants, 93% admitted (exact admit count not given). SAT percentiles are not listed because only 2 enrolled students (1%) submitted SAT scores; the ACT percentiles rest on 260 students (82%). International applicant and admit counts, GPA distribution and SAT total are not available from IPEDS.

cds_test_policy.notes: NSU's undergraduate requirements page says an ACT or SAT score is not required for admission; IPEDS lists SAT/ACT as 'not required, but considered'.
